title: Member Handbook Terms: Returned Payments and Cash-Only Status on Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
These are the terms of Electric Service by Rate Schedule for payments that come back unpaid from the bank or card issuer, and for the cash-only status that repeated returns bring about.

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fee for each payment returned unpaid | $30.00 | $30.00 | $30.00 | $30.00 | $30.00 | $30.00 | $30.00 |
| Returned payments within the look-back that place the account on cash-only status | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Look-back over which returned payments are counted (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Months the account stays on cash-only status, from the triggering return | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Payment channels accepted while on cash-only status | listed below | listed below | listed below | listed below | listed below | listed below | listed below |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

**Channels accepted while an account is on cash-only status (all seven schedules):** office cash, money order, online card, phone IVR card, payment kiosk.

### Terms in plain words

- Each returned payment carries a $30.00 fee on every schedule.
- On every schedule, the 2nd returned payment counted within a 12-month look-back places the account on cash-only status for 12 months, counted from the return that triggered it.
- While on cash-only status, a payment is accepted only through the five channels above. A mailed or office check, an online e-check or an automatic bank draft is not among them.

### Hypothetical case

A Schedule FH account (hypothetical) has one returned payment posted in February and a second posted in November of the same year. The November return is the 2nd within 12 months, so the account goes on cash-only status for 12 months counted from the November return.
